facts.statement: Rhabdodon lived in Europe during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 72 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon (meaning "fluted tooth") is a genus of ornithopod dinosaur that lived in Europe approximately 72-66 million years ago in the Late Cretaceous.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon measured about 4 meters long and weighed 250 kilograms, though some specimens may have reached 6 meters in length.
facts.quote: It was large amongst its relatives, measuring 4 m long and weighing 250 kg, with some specimens possibly reaching up to 6 m long.

facts.statement: Fossils of Rhabdodon have been found in southern France and fragmentary remains in eastern Spain.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon is known from southern France, although fragmentary remains from eastern Spain have been assigned to the genus.

facts.statement: The type species Rhabdodon priscus was originally named by Matheron in 1869 with two different spellings.
facts.quote: The type species was originally named under two spellings by Matheron (1869), Rhabdodon priscum and Rabdodon priscum.

facts.statement: In 1986, Winand Brinkmann petitioned the ICZN to suppress a prior use of the name Rhabdodon by Fleischmann in 1831 and to formalize the specific name as priscus.
facts.quote: In 1986, the Swiss paleontologist Winand Brinkmann submitted an application for the International Code of Zoological Nomenclature (ICZN) to suppress this previous use by Fleischmann (1831) and to amend the specific name to priscus.

facts.statement: Eric Buffetaut and Jean Le Loueff named the species Rhabdodon septimanicus in 1991.
facts.quote: In 1991, the French paleontologists Eric Buffetaut and Jean Le Loueff named the second species R. septimanicus from the Argiles et Grès à Reptiles Formation.

facts.statement: Modern phylogenetic analyses classify Rhabdodon as a basal member of Iguanodontia rather than a hypsilophodont.
facts.quote: all modern phylogenetic analyses find this to be an unnatural grouping, and Rhabdodon to be a basal member of Iguanodontia.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon was likely an herbivore living in Cretaceous Europe.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon was probably an herbivore in Cretaceous Europe.

facts.statement: Isotope analysis indicates that Rhabdodon ate C3 plants.
facts.quote: Isotope analysis shows that Rhabdodon, along with its smaller cousin Zalmoxes, ate C3 plants.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon possessed a hard beak and several rows of teeth that allowed it to crush harder foods.
facts.quote: Poseía un pico duro y varias hileras de dientes que le permitían desmenuzar los alimentos más duros.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon was a running dinosaur measuring 4.5 meters long, 1.7 meters high, and weighing 500 kilograms.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon fue un dinosaurio corredor de 4,5 metros de largo, 1,7 de alto y un peso de 500 kilogramos.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon moved by walking on two legs or four legs alternately.
facts.quote: Se desplazaba alternadamente en dos o en cuatro patas.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon had four fingers on its front limbs for manipulating food and hoof-like nails on its hind feet for rapid escape.
facts.quote: En los miembros delanteros poseía cuatro dedos para manipular los alimentos y las traseras con uñas en forma de cascos que le permitían una rápida huida.

facts.statement: A 2012 study by Ősi et al. suggested Rhabdodon experienced gigantism on the mainland rather than insular dwarfism.
facts.quote: one recent paper (Ősi et al., 2012) determined it is larger than the basal rhabdodontid status; from this they suggested that it actually experienced gigantism on the "mainland" and not insular dwarfism as previous suggested.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon belongs to the family Rhabdodontidae.
facts.quote: familia: Rhabdodontidae

facts.statement: Rhabdodon has had synonyms including Rabdodon, Oligosaurus, and Ornithomerus.
facts.quote: synonyms: Rabdodon Matheron, 1869 Oligosaurus Seeley, 1881 Ornithomerus Seeley, 1881

facts.statement: Rhabdodon lived during the Late Cretaceous (Maastrichtian), approximately 70 to 66 million years ago, in what is now Europe.
facts.quote: que vivieron a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 70 a 66 millones de años, en Maastrichtiense, en lo que hoy es Europa.

facts.statement: The Lo Hueco region where Rhabdodon fossils were found was near the coast of the Tethys Sea.
facts.quote: The study showed that Lo Hueco was near the coast of the Tethys Sea, a large seaway through southern Europe and northern Africa.

facts.statement: The environment near the Lo Hueco fossil site included a brackish-freshwater aquatic area and a muddy floodplain.
facts.quote: The area directly on the coast was shown to be a brackish-freshwater aquatic environment, with a muddy flood-plain beside it.

facts.statement: A 2026 study by Maidment et al. suggested some specimens previously classified as rhabdodontids might actually belong to Ceratopsoidea.
facts.quote: Maidment et al. (2026), on the other hand, recovered multiple specimens usually found to be rhabdodontids to be instead members of Ceratopsoidea.

facts.statement: The species Rhabdodon priscus was named in 1869 by Philippe Matheron.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon priscus es la especie tipo, siendo nombrada en 1869 por Philippe Matheron.

facts.statement: A second species, R. septimanicus, was described in 1991 by Buffetaut and Le Loeuff.
facts.quote: Una segunda especie fue descrita en 1991, R. septimanicus por Buffetaut y Le Loeuff

facts.statement: Remains of Rhabdodon are currently known from southern France, eastern Spain, and Romania.
facts.quote: Actualmente se conocen restos de Rhabdodon en el sur de Francia, aunque se han asignado al género restos fragmentarios del este de España y en Rumania

facts.statement: Similar dinosaur remains, including femur and limb fragments, are known from the Czech Republic.
facts.quote: Restos de dinosaurio muy similares, fragmentos del hueso del fémur y del miembro, también se conocen de la República Checa.

facts.statement: Fossils previously classified under various names included Iguanodon suessi, Oligosaurus adelus, Ornithomerus gracilis, Mochlodon robustus, M. priscus, M. suessi, M. inkeyi, Onychosaurus hungaricus, and Camptosaurus inkeyi.
facts.quote: Y fue así, que aparecen nombres como Iguanodon suessi, Oligosaurus adelus, Ornithomerus gracilis, Mochlodon robustus, M. priscus, M. suessi, M. inkeyi, Onychosaurus hungaricus y Camptosaurus inkeyi.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon is structurally similar to a robust hypsilophodontid but is classified by modern phylogenetic analyses as a basal member of Iguanodontia.
facts.quote: Es similar en construcción a un "hipsilofodonte" muy robusto, un ornitópodo no iguanodontido, aunque todos los análisis filogenéticos modernos encuentran que estos son una agrupación antinatural y que Rhabdodon es un miembro basal de Iguanodontia.

facts.statement: The parent group of Rhabdodon is Rhabdodontidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Rhabdodontidae

facts.statement: Rhabdodon is classified in the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: Rhabdodon lived during the Campanian to Maastrichtian stages, from 83.6 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Maastrichtian (83.6 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Rhabdodon priscus is known from specimens found in the Marnes Rouges Inférieures Formation.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon priscus se conoce a partir de un espécimen de la Formación Marnes Rouges Inférieures.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon priscus is also known from the Gres de Saint-Chinian Formation.
facts.quote: Otra formación de la que se conoce R. priscus es Gres de Saint-Chinian.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon sp. was found in the Lo Hueco region of the late Cretaceous in the Villalba de la Sierra Formation.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon sp. fue hallado la región de Lo Hueco de finales del Cretácico en la Formación Villalba de la Sierra.

facts.statement: The Lo Hueco area was located near the coast of the Tethys Sea, a major waterway across southern Europe and northern Africa.
facts.quote: El estudio mostró que Lo Hueco estaba cerca de la costa del mar de Tetis, una gran vía marítima a través del sur de Europa y el norte de África.

facts.statement: The Lo Hueco area was situated within an alluvial plain.
facts.quote: Se encontró que Lo Hueco estaba dentro de la llanura aluvial.

facts.statement: The coastal area at Lo Hueco was a brackish aquatic environment adjacent to a muddy floodplain.
facts.quote: Se demostró que el área directamente en la costa era un ambiente acuático de agua salobre, con una llanura de inundación fangosa al lado.

facts.statement: The material of R. priscus includes a dentary and many other postcranial remains.
facts.quote: El material de R. priscus incluye un dentario y muchos otros restos poscraneales.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon priscus is one of the few known vertebrates from the Gres de Labarre Formation.
facts.quote: Rhabdodon priscus es uno de los pocos vertebrados conocidos de la Formación Gres de Labarre.

facts.statement: The genus name means "grooved tooth," while the species designation means "primitive."
facts.quote: El nombre del género significa "diente acanalado", mientras que la designación de especie significa "primitivo"

facts.statement: It is debated whether the second species R. septimanicus, described from an isolated jaw fragment, is distinct or belongs to the same species as R. priscus.
facts.quote: Una segunda especie fue descrita en 1991, R. septimanicus por Buffetaut y Le Loeuff, basada en un fragmento aislado de la mandíbula, pero éste puede ser de la misma especie.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon priscus was of small size because it lived in an insular environment like Europe was at that time.
facts.quote: De pequeño tamaño debido a que vivía en un ambiente insular, como era Europa en esa época.

facts.statement: Rhabdodon appears in the Discovery Channel series Dinosaur Planet under the name "dwarf Iguanodon."
facts.quote: Rhabdodon hace su aparición en la serie de televisión de Discovery Channel Dinosaur Planet, bajo el nombre de "Iguanodon enano".
